messages:
elaine: Heads up 1: product asked for per-model SKU cost + a transparent way to show cache-prefetch savings on the cost dashboard. want to avoid surprising customer audits.

nick: can we avoid pushing all amortization math into the realtime API? i'd prefer a phased approach: realtime SKU exposure, offline amortization + reconciles.

raj: big constraint: customers expect CSV exports to match what they see in Console. if amortized shares are delayed, export must mark 'staged' rows.

maria: UX requirement: show 'as-reconciled' vs 'streaming' mode toggle. default to streaming for low latency, let power users pick reconciled.

elaine: agreed. from infra POV we need these minimal event fields: `sku_ref`, `route_id`, `raw_tokens`, `prefetch_trigger_id` (nullable), `hotpath_sample_flag`. keep payload small.

nick: +1 on small fields. prefer `sku_ref` instead of price float. We'll maintain a compact price table keyed by day+sku_ref.

raj: sampling question: if we sample hotpath invocations at 5% for direct allocation, how do we scale allocated credits to total traffic? we need deterministic weights.

elaine: approach: each sampled invocation includes `sample_weight` = 1 / sampling_prob so the aggregator can multiply. keep sample deterministic using `farmhash64(request_id) % 10000 < sample_rate*100`.

lisa: quick UX ask: can the Console show a confidence indicator (low/med/high) on amortized rows when sample coverage < threshold? PMs love a simple signal.

maria: yes. define confidence = min(1, sampled_tokens / estimated_slab_tokens). map to discrete badges.

nick: ingestion impact: adding `prefetch_trigger_id` increases cardinality but it's nullable. we only populate for prefetch events. still need a histogram to justify. i'll run numbers.

raj: about prefetch lineage: one prefetch may serve many routes. allocation options: 1) first-touch attribution, 2) proportional by observed usage, 3) hybrid with hotpath overrides. which do we pick?

elaine: i'd push for hybrid: if hotpath samples exist, use sampled direct allocations; otherwise, amortize proportionally across recent consumers by token footprint. document cases explicitly.

lisa: for auditors, include a column `allocation_method` in export with values {"sampled_direct","amortized_prop","first_touch"}. keep text small.

maria: good. also we need to handle model variant migrations: same logical model can have SKUs sku-a, sku-a-q4. reconcile historical rows so per-model trends are coherent.

nick: versioning plan: pipeline writes `sku_ref` + `sku_family` (nullable). `sku_family` helps group variants in UI without changing invoices. store sku price history separately.

raj: operational note: precompute allocation maps in hourly windows and persist to Redis/OLAP join table. Console will join by (time_window, prefetch_trigger_id) to annotate rows. avoid heavy per-row queries.

elaine: batch job contract: input = sampled invocations + router token footprints + cache slab metrics. output = allocation_map with keys `prefetch_trigger_id` -> list of {route_id, allocated_tokens, method}. keep payload compressed (jsonlines gz).

lisa: UX: expose a "why this credit?" flyout for any cost row that shows source slab id, allocation_method, sample_rate, and a mini sparklines of token usage. helps support teams.

maria: analytics question: do we show both net_cost and gross_cost side-by-side? ops wants gross to track chargeback fairness.

nick: show both; net_cost is primary, gross_cost visible as secondary column. export both.

raj: edgecase: cached responses refreshed mid-invocation chain (LLM chain calls). need to avoid double-counting cache credits across chained requests. add to spec: attach `parent_request_id` when chain present.

elaine: good catch. we'll include `parent_request_id` optional. chain attribution rules: child inherits explicit cache_credit_id if present, else consult parent. add a test in contract.

infra-bot: schema-check: new field list must be added to `costline_event_v2` in schema registry. (automated)

lisa: copy note: tooltip for amortized: "Amortized credits are distributed when direct attribution isn't available; values update after reconciliation window." keep under 140 chars.

maria: timeline: produce minimal event PR + Console stub (columns & badges) in 10 days. full reconciled pipeline + export matching in 5 weeks. acceptable?

nick: i can do backend PR in 1 week for sku_ref + sample flags. raj will lead batch pipeline.

raj: i'll spec the allocation_map schema and cluster requirements. I'll also add a small reconciliation job to validate daily totals vs streaming sums and emit alerts.

elaine: action items recap:
- nick: event schema PR (sku_ref, prefetch_trigger_id, hotpath_sample_flag, parent_request_id)
- raj: batch allocation_map spec + reconcile job
- lisa: Console badges, flyout copy, export columns + confidence legend
- maria: stakeholder announcement + audit checklist

maria: thanks all. feel free to drop mockups into #design or ping me. we'll review progress in Wed sync. :calendar:
